title: What Is Your Spiritual Prayer Language?
intro: Five questions on how you genuinely meet God in your daily life — beyond expectations or formalities.

questions.prompt: When something heavy lands on you, your first instinct is to…

options.text: Go quiet and sit with it before the Lord
Reach out to your prayer circle or intercede for others
Open Scripture and study for biblical precedent
Express it out loud to God, raw and unfiltered

questions.prompt: Your most authentic moments of prayer happen…

options.text: In quiet stillness, without needing words
While holding the burdens of friends and family
With a journal and Bible open side-by-side
In the car or during worship, singing and praying aloud

questions.prompt: A worship or church gathering touches you most deeply when…

options.text: There is unhurried space for silent reflection
The community unites in fervent group intercession
The biblical exposition is rich, historical, and deep
The music and atmosphere lift burdens from your heart

questions.prompt: You feel the closest presence of God when you…

options.text: Are alone in nature observing the stars and sky
Have just comforted someone in distress
Finally illuminate the deeper meaning of a passage
Are deeply moved by beauty, gratitude, or praise

questions.prompt: The short prayer that resonates most with your heart is…

options.text: “Speak, Lord, for Your servant hears.”
“Lord, remember them and heal their wounds.”
“Open my eyes that I may behold wondrous things.”
“Create in me a clean heart, O God!”

contemplative.title: The Contemplative Heart
contemplative.body: You meet God best in quiet solitude. Like Elijah on Mount Horeb, you recognize that the Lord speaks not merely in the thunder, but in the still, small whisper. Your quiet stillness is a sacred gift.

intercessory.title: The Faithful Intercessor
intercessory.body: You carry people with deep maternal and spiritual devotion. 'Bear one another’s burdens' (Galatians 6:2) is your natural rhythm. Your prayers are shields for your family and community.

scriptural.title: The Berean Scholar
scriptural.body: You encounter God through His Living Word. Like Mary sitting attentively at Jesus' feet, you prize understanding, theological depth, and the historical truth of the Mazzaroth.

expressive.title: The Psalmist
expressive.body: You worship with your whole being—in tears, song, and joyful praise. Like King David, your emotional honesty before God is a reflection of profound faith and vibrant vitality.

title: Where Is God Building Spiritual Patience In You?
intro: A gentle biblical reflection on the areas of life currently undergoing slow, enduring construction.

questions.prompt: The delay that tests your faith most right now is related to…

options.text: A vocational calling or project not yet realized
A relationship or healing needed under your roof
Personal physical strength, health, or energy
A long-standing prayer you have waited years to see answered

questions.prompt: Looking ahead five years, the milestone you most yearn for is…

options.text: Clarity and fulfillment in your divine purpose
Peace and generational harmony in your household
Renewed physical vitality and balanced wellness
Witnessing God's promised breakthrough come to pass

questions.prompt: When you feel spiritually tested, you remind yourself that…

options.text: Joseph waited 13 years between the dream and the throne
Love suffers long and is always kind
God's strength is made perfect in human weakness
The Lord is not slow in keeping His promises

vocation.title: Patience in Divine Calling
vocation.body: God is establishing a deep foundation in your life's work. What seems like a delay is divine preparation, ensuring you have the wisdom and character to sustain future fruitfulness.

family.title: Patience in the Household
family.body: Your home is your primary ministry. What is built with patience and prayer over seasons will endure for generations.

body.title: Patience with the Physical Frame
body.body: Give yourself grace. God honors your faithful perseverance through physical limitations, refining your dependence on His daily sustaining breath.

waiting.title: The Unwavering Promise
waiting.body: Do not stop believing. In God's perfect timing, what has been watered with faithful tears will blossom into testimony.

title: What Do You Truly Treasure?
intro: Discover what your heart cherishes most: 'Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also' (Matthew 6:21).

questions.prompt: A restorative afternoon for your soul includes…

options.text: Total tranquility without conflict or noise
Arranging your home or admiring radiant art and gardens
Preparing a blessing or meal for someone in need
Deep, uninterrupted conversation with a cherished loved one

questions.prompt: You feel most appreciated when others notice…

options.text: The calming, peaceful spirit you bring to the space
The beauty, order, and care you have created
The tireless acts of service you quietly performed
Your unwavering loyalty and steadfast love

peace.title: You Treasure God's Peace
peace.body: You bring reconciliation and serenity wherever you go. Blessed are the peacemakers, for they reflect the heart of the Prince of Peace.

beauty.title: You Treasure Sacred Beauty
beauty.body: You recognize God's signature in symmetry, nature, and light. Your aesthetic eye is a liturgical gift that draws others toward worship.

service.title: You Treasure Faithful Service
service.body: You love through concrete acts of kindness, hospitality, and care. Your hands are the hands of Christ in everyday life.

devotion.title: You Treasure Covenant Loyalty
devotion.body: You value authentic, singular devotion. You love deeply, mirroring the unfailing covenant love of the Lord.
